entry.title: 5G CATS: 5G-Based Cryptographic Authorization Against Trafficking of Semiconductor Devices
entry.summary:
Enforcing export controls on AI accelerators requires verifying where a chip operates after deployment. Round-trip time measurements can bound a chip's distance from a trusted landmark, but any jitter in honest replies forces the verifier to loosen its timeout, giving an attacker slack to relay traffic over fiber from a restricted region. Prior approaches either cross the untrusted host stack or rely on noisy power-line channels that inflate this slack.

Source: arXiv Systems & Architecture (cs.OS, cs.AR, cs.NI, cs.PF) · Tags: #computer-architecture #kernel-os #cryptography #networking

entry.title: An Improved $(1+2e)$-Approximation Algorithm for Metric Data Placement
entry.summary:
We study the metric data placement problem with site-capacity constraints and fixed installation costs, aiming to minimize the total cost of placing data (resources) and accessing their nearest copies. We develop a deterministic polynomial-time approximation algorithm based on a natural linear programming relaxation of the problem. Starting from an optimal fractional solution, we construct multiscale metric-ball partitions independently for each resource and connect overlapping balls at consecutive levels to form a flow network.

Source: arXiv Systems & Architecture (cs.OS, cs.AR, cs.NI, cs.PF) · Tags: #computer-architecture #kernel-os #algorithms #decision-theory
